description: This file implements network interface and address management functionalities, including platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems, as well as classes for iterating over network adapters and handling network routes and configurations.
external_files: <Windows-specific headers like iphlpapi.h, ws2ipdef.h, etc. if on Windows>
<POSIX-specific headers like arpa/inet.h, ifaddrs.h, etc. if on POSIX>

classes.name: Network
classes.description: Represents a network interface, providing methods to check status, enable/disable, set gateway, and update interface properties.

classes.name: AdapterIterator
classes.description: Iterates over network adapters, providing access to MAC address, name, status, and management of IP addresses.

classes.name: IPNode
classes.description: Represents an IP address node, supporting IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

classes.name: NodeId
classes.description: Identifier for network nodes, supporting IPv4 and IPv6.

classes.name: RoutingTable
classes.description: Represents the system's routing table, allowing retrieval of routes.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Represents a network route with destination, gateway, interface, and other attributes.

classes.name: IPNetworks
classes.description: Singleton class managing network interfaces and addresses, with platform-specific implementations for Windows and POSIX.

classes.name: AdapterObserver
classes.description: Observer class for network adapter events, such as link state changes.

methods.name: LoadAdapterInfo
methods.description: Loads network adapter information on Windows.

methods.name: ConvertMACToString
methods.description: Converts a MAC address byte array to a string representation.

methods.name: Address
methods.description: Returns the IP address at a specific index for an adapter.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an IP address to the network interface.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes an IP address from the network interface.

methods.name: Gateway
methods.description: Sets the gateway for a network.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates network interface properties based on netlink messages.
